'''''Kenny G''''' is the debut studio album by American [[jazz]] [[saxophonist]] [[Kenny G]], released in 1982 by [[Arista Records]]. It reached number 10 on the ''Billboard'' Jazz Albums chart.

#"[[Mercy, Mercy, Mercy]]" – 3:41 ([[Joe Zawinul]])
